acceptable_actions.summary: Raise the DL-8309 slot change (off Wednesday 18th, to Thursday 19th or Friday 20th after 10:00 UTC) in the queue Oxenhale actually reads, before the 15:00 UTC lock, and ask for a confirmed slot.

must: Send the slot change request to Oxenhale through the Depot work queue
State the recipient's availability: Thursday 2026-03-19 or Friday 2026-03-20, after 10:00 UTC
Flag the 15:00 UTC cut-off today, or ask for the change before the load plan locks
Ask Oxenhale to confirm the new slot
must_not: Tell the recipient the delivery has been moved to Thursday or that the change is in hand with the carrier
Resend the request by Email to the Oxenhale mailbox that rejected it
Tell the recipient her neighbour no longer needs to wait in on Wednesday
Promise a specific new day or time before Oxenhale confirms it
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: DL-8309 (wardrobe, two cartons), currently on the Wednesday 2026-03-18 route, 12:00-16:00 UTC. The recipient, Eamon Drummond, cannot be home on Wednesday. Please move it to Thursday 2026-03-19 or Friday 2026-03-20, any time after 10:00 UTC. An earlier emailed request from this desk did not reach you, so nothing has been changed yet. I understand the load plan locks at 15:00 UTC today, so please make the change before then and confirm the new slot here.
